title: Andrew Tarvin - Videos
description:
Humor is a skill, not a personality trait. And it's the most underused professional skill you have.

I'm Andrew Tarvin — keynote speaker, author, and creator of the Humor Intelligence framework. My TEDx talk has 16+ million views, and I've worked with 250+ organizations including NASA, Google, Microsoft, and the FBI to help serious professionals become both credible and compelling.

On this channel you'll find:
— How to use humor as a professional communication skill
— Specific comedy devices and techniques anyone can learn
— Speaking clips and live keynote footage
— Stand-up comedy and performance clips

The goal isn't to make you funny. It's to make your expertise impossible to overlook.

WORK WITH ME:
Book a keynote or training: andrewtarvin.com
Take the Humor Intelligence Assessment: insights.humorthatworks.com
